description: Sample JSON payloads for Area Reporter API

upload_request.description: POST /api/reports — Upload a new report to the server

example.title: Large pothole near school
example.description: There is a deep pothole approximately 30cm wide causing danger to cyclists and motorcyclists near the main school gate.

upload_response_failure.description: Failed upload response (triggers retry with exponential backoff)

sample_reports.title: Garbage overflowing near park
sample_reports.description: The municipality bins near Central Park have been overflowing for 3 days. Waste is spilling onto the footpath.

sample_reports.title: Water pipe burst on MG Road
sample_reports.description: A water pipe has burst creating a large pool on MG Road. Water is wasting and road is flooded.

sample_reports.title: 3 street lights out on Highway
sample_reports.description: Three consecutive street lights are non-functional making the highway very dark and dangerous at night.
